{
  "rules": [
    "If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; apply downward bias correction.",
    "If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) or volatile, model underestimates; apply upward bias correction.",
    "After a sharp price spike (forecast > 65.0), model often overshoots and fails to correct; reduce forecast slope by 10–15% in next 5–7 days.",
    "When true outcome shows strong mean reversion (e.g., 65→60→55), model persists in upward trend; adjust forecast to reflect diminishing momentum.",
    "If forecast is flat (±0.01) over 3–5 days and sentiment is neutral, true outcome often diverges; introduce small upward or downward drift based on sentiment polarity.",
    "For 30-day horizon, if forecast is >64.0 and true outcome drops below 60.0 within 10 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0 per day until convergence.",
    "If sentiment history shows repeated 0.00 values (neutral or bearish), model underperforms; increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices."
  ]
}
